config.experiment: 022-attr-platform (H-A3, D-018 cycle; docs/08 H-A3 + docs/09 pre-registration, frozen)

data.folds: sklearn GroupKFold(5) over devices (sorted, deterministic); all copies and all conditions of a photo are in one device group

config.launder_key: sha256 of the raw file (same key as 004 load_cond); experiments/lib/perturb.apply_condition; A launders the NATIVE decoded image, B uses the 004 cached features (laundering applied to the fov512 crop)
config.primary_train_mode_why: docs/08 Common definitions: Training = T-mix. clean-train transfer is reported as sensitivity (docs/08 gate 4) with its own label.

method_A.luma: Y = 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B of the decoded RGB (no EXIF transpose: the as-stored grid is the object; no metadata read)
method_A.dct: 8x8 orthonormal DCT-II of (Y-128) on the native grid, origin top-left, cropped to multiples of 8

hist.note: values clipped into the end bins, normalised to sum 1 per coefficient: 15 x 64 = 960 features

periodicity.rule: phi(s)=|mean exp(2*pi*i*c/s)|; contrast C(s)=phi(s)-0.5*(phi(s-1)+phi(s+1)); s_hat = largest s with C(s)>=0.8*max C; features s_hat and C(s_hat) per coefficient = 30

method_B.layout: 004 secondary 4608-d = [blk4 CLS|blk4 mean|blk8 CLS|blk8 mean|blk12 CLS|blk12 mean]
method_B.block_choice: highest mean inner grouped-CV balanced accuracy on the training fold

probe.model: StandardScaler + multinomial L2 logistic, class_weight balanced
probe.inner_cv: GroupKFold(5) by device on the training fold, score = balanced accuracy

m0.features: log2 w, log2 h, aspect, file bytes, bytes/pixel, mean luma/chroma quantisation step, one-hot of quantisation-table hash (train hashes)
m0.conditions: clean (raw files) only; undefined after in-memory laundering
m0.preprocessed_tensor_check: same pipeline on (w,h,aspect,format) of the fov512 PNGs (constant) -> must equal chance

permutation.scheme: labels shuffled within each photo triplet (device,vidx), 200 shuffles, primary (T-mix) protocol, C fixed to the median C chosen in the real run (per method), block fixed to the modal block for B
permutation.gate: mean permuted bacc within 1/3 +- 0.02 for every method x condition

config.label_rule: PASS if (A or B) has clean>=0.80 AND social_sim>=0.60 (point estimates, primary train mode); KILL if A clean<0.60 AND B clean<0.50 (clean, primary train mode); else INCONCLUSIVE. counts_as_failure (docs/09 decision 1): KILL, or INCONCLUSIVE with max(A_clean,B_clean) < 0.80 (point estimate does not reach the PASS clean bar). Chosen before any result.

vision.features: DINOv2 fov512 block 4 (CLS+mean), native images, clean
vision.model_sets: devices sharing the folder model name
vision.design: binary 'is model M': train = device A positives vs half of the non-M devices; test = same-model device B positives vs the other half; AUROC. control: positives from a device C of a different model vs other-model negatives.

hdrplus.features: 019 cache fov512 clean, block 4 primary (b8,b12 descriptive)

config.d008: no new GPU pass: method B reads only the existing 004 fov512 caches (their D-008 guard: 004 cache/fov512/d008_guard.json); method A is CPU numpy

vision_same_model_transfer.note: CI = bootstrap over ordered device pairs only; exploratory, no label
